verdict.rationale: Pipedream provides per-app reference pages listing tools/actions (e.g., openai.md, clickup.md) plus a hosted chat app and MCP demo where users can try out tool calls interactively, which partially satisfies the 'interactive reference with runnable examples' story. However, there's no evidence of a true live/sandboxed API reference UI (like Swagger/Postman-style docs) with inline runnable code snippets per endpoint. missing for 10: dedicated interactive API-reference UI, in-browser runnable code snippets per tool/endpoint, independent user corroboration of the reference experience.
